#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with title 'Annual Financial Report' and current date."""
import os
from datetime import datetime

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

SRC = "report.pdf"
OUT = "report.pdf"  # add cover page into report.pdf itself
COVER = "cover_page.pdf"

if not os.path.exists(SRC):
    raise SystemExit(f"ERROR: {SRC} not found in {os.getcwd()}")

# 1) Create the cover page (letter size) with the title and current date
width, height = letter
c = canvas.Canvas(COVER, pagesize=letter)

c.setFillColorRGB(0.09, 0.20, 0.36)  # dark navy accent bar
c.rect(0, height - 120, width, 120, stroke=0, fill=1)

c.setFillColorRGB(1, 1, 1)
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 80, "Annual Financial Report")

c.setFillColorRGB(0, 0, 0)
c.setFont("Helvetica", 14)
date_str = datetime.now().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 - 30, date_str)

c.save()

# 2) Prepend the cover page to report.pdf
reader = PdfReader(SRC)
cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER)

writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(OUT, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

print(f"OK: cover page prepended to {OUT} ({len(writer.pages)} pages total)")
print(f"Cover date: {date_str}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with title 'Annual Financial Report' and current date.

reportlab is unavailable, so the cover page is generated as a minimal valid PDF
built directly (one letter-size page with a navy banner, title, and date),
then prepended to report.pdf with pypdf.
"""
import os
from datetime import datetime

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

SRC = "report.pdf"
OUT = "report.pdf"  # add cover page into report.pdf itself
COVER = "cover_page.pdf"

if not os.path.exists(SRC):
    raise SystemExit(f"ERROR: {SRC} not found in {os.getcwd()}")


def esc(s: str) -> str:
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def est_width(text: str, size: float, factor: float) -> float:
    """Rough Helvetica text width estimate for centering."""
    return len(text) * size * factor


# --- Cover page content -----------------------------------------------------
title = "Annual Financial Report"
date_str = datetime.now().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612, 792  # US Letter

title_size = 30
date_size = 14
title_x = (PAGE_W - est_width(title, title_size, 0.62)) / 2
date_x = (PAGE_W - est_width(date_str, date_size, 0.55)) / 2

# Navy banner at the top of the page, white bold title inside it, date centered
# lower on the page.
stream = f"""q
0.09 0.20 0.36 rg
0 {PAGE_H - 120} {PAGE_W} 120 re
f
Q
BT
/F1 {title_size} Tf
1 1 1 rg
{title_x:.2f} {PAGE_H - 82} Td
({esc(title)}) Tj
ET
BT
/F2 {date_size} Tf
0 0 0 rg
{date_x:.2f} {PAGE_H / 2 - 30} Td
({esc(date_str)}) Tj
ET
""".encode("latin-1")

objs = [
    "<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
    "<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
    "<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
    "/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R /F2 5 0 R >> >> /Contents 6 0 R >>",
    "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>",
    "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
    f"<< /Length {len(stream)} >>\nstream\n".encode("latin-1")
    + stream
    + b"\nendstream",
]

# --- Assemble cover PDF with correct xref offsets ---------------------------
data = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
offsets = [0]
for i, body in enumerate(objs, start=1):
    offsets.append(len(data))
    data += f"{i} 0 obj\n".encode("latin-1")
    data += body.encode("latin-1") + b"\n"
    data += b"endobj\n"

xref_pos = len(data)
data += f"xref\n0 {len(objs) + 1}\n".encode("latin-1")
data += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
for off in offsets[1:]:
    data += f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("latin-1")
data += (
    f"trailer\n<< /Size {len(objs) + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\n"
    f"startxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n"
).encode("latin-1")

with open(COVER, "wb") as f:
    f.write(data)

# --- Prepend cover page to report.pdf ---------------------------------------
reader = PdfReader(SRC)
cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER)

writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(OUT, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

print(f"OK: cover page prepended to {OUT} ({len(writer.pages)} pages total)")
print(f"Cover title: {title}")
print(f"Cover date: {date_str}")
